paragraphs.text: Die is an acorn token creature type used for cards which depict an animated die. The dice appear as large dog sized, dotted, cubiform creatures with legs and arms which wield weapons.

Die debuted as a creature type in Unsanctioned on tokens created by Pippa, Duchess of Dice . The tokens use the dice rolling mechanic to determine their power and toughness with the rolled dice becoming the token.
